justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/Evaluator.java, src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java, and src/test/java/org/jsoup/select/EvaluatorTest.java. The class is a tiny leaf evaluator with only one field and one match call to Element.wholeOwnText().contains(...), so its fan-out is minimal. Repository-wide search found only one production instantiation in QueryParser.containsWholeText(boolean) plus one test instantiation in EvaluatorTest; no broader fan-in/fan-out hub behavior is present.
